items:

Location: Blue Mountain Beach
Address: 230 Blue Lake Road, Santa Rosa Beach, FL

Details:
Experience the height of opulence at Carousel, one of the most stunning Blue Mountain vacation rentals along Florida’s iconic 30A. This exquisite estate offers breathtaking Gulf views and sits within steps of beach access in the highly desirable Blue Mountain Beach community. Featuring a large private pool, expansive backyard oasis, and private gym, Carousel embodies everything guests look for in 30A vacation rentals with a private pool and modern luxury. This remarkable, newer 30A luxury vacation rental has been meticulously designed without sparing a single detail, ensuring the most captivating coastal escape imaginable. The interior showcases state-of-the-art amenities and designer finishes, while the exterior maximizes sweeping Gulf views and provides the exclusivity and privacy discerning travelers expect from 30A luxury rentals.

Nestled on an oversized double corner lot, Carousel is just one home away from direct beach access and within half a mile of top dining, shopping, and entertainment. A custom elevator adorned with hand-painted murals provides access to all four floors, making it easy for everyone to enjoy every inch of this exceptional home. Each of the seven bedrooms includes its own en-suite bathroom, and the home’s thoughtful layout allows beach views from nearly every room. With parking for up to six vehicles and exceptional space for gatherings, Carousel is the ideal getaway for extended families, retreats, or milestone celebrations. For travelers seeking vacation rentals on 30A that blend sophistication, comfort, and proximity to the beach, Carousel stands above the rest.

Don’t miss your chance to experience this unparalleled retreat—book Carousel today and discover why it’s one of the most extraordinary luxury 30A rentals available.

This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.

Reviewer Comments:
We are a family of 24 spanning three generations. We like to share one house ( vs individual condos) to get the extra early-morning coffee time and late-night discussions. It’s hard to find a “perfect” rental that is pleasing to all, but this house hits the mark every time! The kitchen is the best around- it’s actually equipped and user friendly- we cook all meals in. The location is lovely- there’s a view of some form of vegetation out of every window. The 4th floor outdoor space is awesome!

responses.response:
Sarah, thank you so much for your detailed feedback! We’re thrilled to hear Carousel was such a great fit for your group—from the comfy beds and spacious layout to the yard games, bikes, and those incredible fourth-floor views. We’re also glad our team was able to assist quickly whenever you needed us.

We appreciate your note on the pool door alarm. This safety feature is required by Florida law in every rental home with pool access, as it helps ensure an added layer of protection—especially for families with young children. 

We’re so glad you had a wonderful stay overall, and we’d love to welcome you back for another beach getaway soon!

Reviewer Comments:
This was a great home with plenty of room for everyone! The area is quiet with natural beauty at every turn, but still close enough to plenty of shops and restuarants if you want to get out and about. The included bikes were utilized, and the fourth floor porch is a great hang out spot that can seat up to 14 comfortably - stunning views! Beds, were comfy, bathrooms large and modern, lots of extra blankets and throws and plenty of seating for everyone.The games in the yard were so much fun too. Royal Destinations was available to answer all questions in an extremely timely manner. Two thumbs up! One thing to note - there is a buzzer that goes off every single time you go out the back sliding doors unless you hit a button prior to exiting. Evidently it is Florida law to have this due to the way this pool has access from the house (it is a safety feature). If you have young children you may see it as a bonus - for us, in truth - this was the biggest downside of the property as it was going off constantly because we would fail to remember to hit the button. It would also go off if you did not shut the doors exactly right.
